description: "An Epic of Women, and Other Poems" by Arthur William Edgar O'Shaughnessy is a collection of poems written in the late 19th century. The work delves into themes of love, longing, and the complexities of femininity, portraying various aspects of womanhood through vivid imagery and lyrical expressions.
